pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: top of the central motor housing (rudder mechanism)

pedals.axis.brake_left.name: Left toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_left.note: toe part of the left pedal plate

pedals.axis.brake_right.name: Right toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_right.note: toe part of the right pedal plate

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the FFB-G rudder pedals seen from the pilot's side, front left, slightly from above; motor housing in the middle, a pedal on each side
mappingSource: catalog brunner.json (source https://brunner-innovation.swiss/product/ffb-g-rudder/, now https://shop.brunner-simulation.ch/product/ffb-g-rudder/): rudder + left/right toe brake, no input numbers in the catalog; toe brakes on the CLS-E rudder confirmed by owners (MSFS forum https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/brunner-force-feedback-yoke-and-rudder-pedals/583954, A2A forum), the product page names only the yaw axis
note: Left/right follow from the viewing direction (heel tubes and the labeled housing front face the camera, so the photo-left pedal is the pilot's left). Toe brakes are marked on the upper (toe) part of each pedal plate; the rudder at the top of the central housing. Owners report the toe brakes reach the sim via CLS2Sim and are not always seen as plain DirectInput axes.
